title: Avoid predictable temporary-file creation
why: Creating a known path in a shared temporary directory can follow an attacker-controlled link or overwrite another process's file.
suggestion: Use mktemp without -u, retain the created path, set restrictive permissions, and remove it with a trap.
limitations: Detection covers mktemp dry-run mode and direct creation or redirection to static /tmp paths.
Platform-specific temporary directories outside /tmp are not inferred.
